scope: INTEL IVOAI-190/198/191 functional availability; no economic acceptance

current_findings.finding: Common scope/inventory/read-policy admission is already independent; every successful factory return nevertheless requires managed Graft identity and Node.
Direct exact Go AST, small-file and literal routes exist, but cached structural preference and the structural candidate currently presume availability.
Query currently creates/locks/invalidates cache and snapshots before runProcess refuses missing runtime paths. A factory-only early return is insufficient.

code_inspect/graft_find_code/graft_file_api use Inspect; grouped literal/call graph/map/check aliases use Query. The error response is already bounded and avoids claiming inferred structural evidence.

recommended_minimal_design: Retain public App factory/Core/MCP signatures, schemas and exact grants. Add only an internal, host-created immutable Direct-only restriction in codeintel.Provider via a small internal-package constructor/helper; do not infer permission from missing runtime fields, model input or prompt.

Keep Identity, Inventory and filesystem policy admission, state parsing failures and source bounds. Produce Direct-only only for a narrowly proven optional-absence condition; clear Node/Distribution/Executable and retain normal scoped CacheRoot/Allowed. No auto-install, index build, configuration write or external executable.

Conservative absence rule for the first increment: missing/zero-value uninstalled component plus no active supply-chain object, or genuinely ENOENT managed Node after the existing Graft identity validation. An installed/managed record with missing active artifact, malformed state, unknown version, unexpected path/revision, unsafe directory/symlink, unreadable metadata or failed payload integrity remains the existing error, not a silent fallback. External/unmanaged installs are never adopted; ambiguous state stays unavailable pending an explicit contract.

Direct-only Query returns a typed bounded structural-unavailable error after normal policy/scope/query validation but before cache mutation, queue/index/result reuse or execution. The existing deferred observation must not mark an unattempted Graft process as attempted.

Direct-only Inspect skips the warm structural-result preference and marks the structural routing candidate unavailable. Preserve exact grep/small-file/unique valid Go declaration paths; missing/ambiguous declarations, malformed/mixed-language identity, large-file skeleton and relational operations refuse when no permitted exact Direct answer exists.
Preserve the full valid-managed-runtime path and its current supply-chain checks. Do not alter structural policy or reclassify literal matches as caller/dependency evidence.

Keep MCP names/contracts stable: direct-capable aliases may succeed through Inspect; structural aliases keep the existing bounded IsError. Existing tool projection and per-turn authorization remain outside and authoritative. Availability does not grant capabilities.

Keep exact ArtifactStore/Gateway provenance, owner and generation checks. Clear runtime paths for Direct-only so its existing Gateway query namespace differs from validated Graft; test that an old structural cache cannot satisfy a Direct-only structural request. Primary/worker admission and post-read refresh are unchanged.
meaningful_tests: Public App factory on a real disposable Git fixture with no Graft/Node returns authorized Direct-only; direct API, literal and exact Go declaration retain exact bytes and ProviderVersion=direct, with zero executable tripwire calls.
Structural/malformed/ambiguous/large-file requests fail before structural cache or index/result mutation and before any runner call, including a previously populated structural result cache.
A cost history that favors Graft cannot route a Direct-only literal query to it. A warm structural cache cannot defeat exact Direct availability.

Existing TestNativeCodeProviderRequiresExpectedVerifiedArtifact wrong-revision and tampered-payload refusals remain strict; add explicit absent-versus-corrupt/missing-managed-object/unsafe-Node cases rather than weakening its assertions.

Exercise actual public factory through primary admitted evidence and MCP direct-capable alias, plus worker allowed/denied exact grants; recover exact owner-bound bytes, reject unauthorized owner/scope/task and preserve no source-to-instruction escalation.

Retain verified structural control using existing synthetic testProvider without installing/launching Graft, plus MCP structural IsError/no inference assertions. Focused App/CodeIntel race and vet; Linux amd64/v1 and ARM64 compilation. A final broader CI belongs to its exact frozen head, not an inherited receipt.
compatibility_and_license: No new package/module/database/framework/orchestrator or external license: Direct is existing repository code using Go standard parser and existing MIT repository license. Do not change Graft notices/license or distribution pins.

No feature flag appears necessary for the built-in already-authorized read capability; the change widens functional availability, not grants. Existing Gateway/protected creation flags remain independent and unchanged.

Native MCP endpoint can now appear in repositories with supported sources even without optional Graft; ensure it is freshly host-projected after the persisted endpoint was removed, never adopted from configuration. Structural names may be listed but must return explicit unavailable rather than execute.
Rollback is a cohesive code/test revert; no schema/data migration, cache deletion, credential or personal configuration changes. No performance/token benefit is asserted.
